title: drl-cox: distributionally robust Cox regression in Python
description: Python implementation of the Wasserstein distributionally robust Cox regression model (DRL-Cox) introduced by Jin, Wise and Paschalidis (CHIL 2025), with classical Cox baselines, censoring-aware evaluation metrics, preprocessing utilities and a scikit-learn compatible estimator. The solver builds the exponential-cone program with CVXPY.
references: Jin, Y., Wise, L., & Paschalidis, I. Ch. (2025). Distributionally Robust Learning in Survival Analysis. Proceedings of the Conference on Health, Inference, and Learning (CHIL), PMLR 287:1-12. https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01348
